claims.claim_text: On 2026-09-30, KOSPI fell about 0.48%, KOSDAQ rose about 0.7%, Samsung Electronics fell, and SK hynix rose.

numeric_parse.observed: Not available; the supplied ^KS11 snapshot is not a September 30 closing-return record.

claims.investor_implication: Confirm KRX closing data before treating the reported divergence as a market signal.

claims.claim_text: Foreign futures selling persisted into the close; investor flows diverged for four sessions; late futures buying exceeded KRW 1 trillion on the preceding session. Quarter-end program trading is offered as a possible cause.

numeric_parse.claimed: Four sessions of divergent flows; more than KRW 1 trillion of late futures buying

claims.investor_implication: Do not rely on a presumed month-start reversal without dated flow data.

claims.claim_text: Samsung Electronics and SK hynix had favorable August–September export trends, and Samsung's preliminary earnings were due in early October.

numeric_parse.claimed: August–September 2026 exports; preliminary results in early October 2026

claims.investor_implication: Separate sector export data from company results when assessing earnings expectations.

claims.claim_text: Micron earnings would arrive the following morning in Korea; results versus expectations and next-quarter guidance would matter for Korean memory stocks.

numeric_parse.observed: Micron earnings headlines appeared on October 1 Korea time; exact release time and figures are unavailable.

claims.investor_implication: Check Micron's original release and guidance against a timestamped pre-release consensus before inferring an effect on Korean memory shares.

claims.claim_text: Vera Rubin-related HBM4 shipments or orders had begun, and the current quarter was the first transition from Blackwell Ultra to HBM4.

numeric_parse.claimed: Shipments or orders already begun; first transition quarter

claims.investor_implication: Treat HBM4 order and transition claims as unconfirmed until primary company statements specify product, customer, and timing.

claims.claim_text: Semiconductor component shares rose for more than a week while other themes typically lasted one to three days; short covering contributed to battery and pharmaceutical rebounds.

numeric_parse.claimed: Semiconductor rise longer than one week; other themes one to three days

claims.investor_implication: Avoid extrapolating theme duration or attributing a rebound to short covering without stock-level evidence.

claims.claim_text: A PCE inflation release was due 'today' or 'tomorrow' and would inform rate expectations.

numeric_parse.claimed: PCE release on 'today' or 'tomorrow' relative to the video

claims.investor_implication: Use the BEA release date and actual data, rather than the video's relative wording, to time any macro assessment.

claims.claim_text: October and November rate-hike probabilities exceeded 60% and 50%, respectively; the policy rate was 4.0%; the dot plot anticipated another hike, while New York Fed President Williams urged caution.

numeric_parse.claimed: October hike probability >60%; November >50%; policy rate 4.0%

claims.investor_implication: Do not use these probabilities or policy-rate figures without identifying the meeting, snapshot time, and original central-bank text.

numeric_parse.claimed: U.S. 10-year yield >5%; oil >USD 100/barrel; September policy-rate increases

claims.investor_implication: Do not build a macro thesis from these thresholds or policy events until each is checked against dated primary data.

claims.claim_text: October policy and AI-infrastructure expectations could benefit power, cable, and nuclear shares, while semiconductors could lead a year-end rise.

numeric_parse.claimed: Potential October catalyst and year-end rise
numeric_parse.observed: Not yet established by supplied evidence

claims.investor_implication: Monitor actual policy announcements, orders, earnings, and subsequent returns; do not present the forecast as a confirmed catalyst.

entities.name: 코스피·코스닥 및 외국인 수급
claims: 9월 30일 코스피 하락과 코스닥 상승의 엇갈림은 전면적 하락 추세보다 단기 수급 불균형에 가깝다는 해석이다.
외국인 선물 매도가 장 마감까지 이어졌지만, 발언자는 월말·분기말 프로그램 거래의 영향일 수 있으며 월초 매수 전환 여부가 중요하다고 본다.
numeric_claims: 당일 코스피 약 0.48% 하락, 코스닥 약 0.7% 상승이라고 언급했다.
최근 4거래일 연속 외국인·기관과 개인의 수급이 엇갈렸다고 언급했다.
앞선 거래일 장 마감 무렵 선물 매수세가 1조 원 넘게 유입됐다고 언급했다.
verification_notes: 공개 시장 스냅샷은 조회됐지만 영상 주장을 직접 대조할 수 있는 검증 규칙이 없어 미검증으로 분류했습니다.
